# Modules

## Layout (every module, generated by `pnpm new:module <name>`)

- `src/domain/`: entities (`Schema.Class`), value objects, policies, domain errors, events. Pure: imports only `effect` and `@arv/kernel`.
- `src/application/`: `ports.ts` (`Context.Tag` ports), one file per use case (plain Effect function), `<name>-api.ts` (facade for other modules and the host).
- `src/infrastructure/`: `schema.ts` (`pgSchema('<name>')` tables) and `drizzle-*-repository.ts` adapters implementing ports. Only this folder imports `@arv/db` and `drizzle-orm`.
- `src/http/`: `routes.ts` (Hono sub-app on `HttpEnv`, `export type <Name>Routes`) and `presenter.ts` (domain → contract DTO, domain error → contract error). Only this folder imports `hono`, `@arv/contracts/*` and `@arv/platform/http`.
- `src/layer.ts`: `<Name>ModuleLive`. `src/index.ts`: the public API (facade tag, public IDs, public events). Nothing else is exported.
- `package.json` `exports` lists only `.`, `./http`, `./layer`.
- `modules/_template` is not a workspace package; edit it only to change what new modules start with.

## Writing code

- Ports are `Context.Tag`s, adapters are `Layer`s. A use case asks for ports with `yield*`, never for concrete adapters.
- Ports have no DB error channel: adapters wrap every query in `query()` and `Effect.orDie`.
- Use another module only through its facade tag, from `application/`. Never pass Drizzle rows across a module boundary; use domain types and branded IDs.
- IDs used by several modules live in `@arv/kernel`; module-local IDs stay in `domain/`.
- Routes keep their public paths: the host mounts each module at `/`, so prefix paths in `routes.ts`.
- Keep facades small: add a method only when another module or the host needs it.

## New module checklist

1. `pnpm new:module <name>`, then `pnpm install`.
2. Add `<Name>ModuleLive` to `apps/api/src/composition.ts` in dependency order (dependents before the modules they call).
3. Mount `<name>Routes` in `apps/api/src/index.ts` and re-export `<Name>Routes`.
4. Add the schema name to `schemaFilter` in `packages/migrations/drizzle.config.ts`, then `pnpm db:generate`.
5. Add the module and its edges to the `module-graph` block and catalog in `ARCHITECTURE.md`, and to `.github/CODEOWNERS`.

## Tests

- Domain and presenter: plain unit tests, no Layers.
- Application: in-memory ports and fake facades via `Layer.succeed`.
- Adapters and routes: `apps/api/test/integration/<module>/` (needs docker).
